name: Dominik Scherm
bio: Dominik is the founder of Space Browser, a mobile browser made for power users. Besides that he is running an agency business for web and app development (www.dnd.one) in Berlin. By the age of 15 he started developing iOS applications with Objective-C and founded his first own startup by the age of 17, where they have built an organising and communication platform for schools in Germany.
